answer: Every identity presents a model fingerprint that stays stable across epochs and differs from every other entry in the registry. Two accounts answering from the same weights are collapsed and both lose the slot, and the failure is published, so the penalty outlives the attempt. A fingerprint is a crystal: hard, fixed, easy to compare. One audit caught forty accounts on a single fine-tune; that lagoon of lookalikes drained in one close, and each vesting garden reset to zero.
